::: {.callout-important}
## Important Disclaimer
This project contains synthetic data and analysis created for demonstration purposes only.
:::

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(gt)
library(plotly)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)

# Check if data exists, generate if needed
if(!file.exists("data/synthetic-schools.csv")) {
  source("data/generate_data.R")
}

# Load synthetic data - read after comment header lines
schools <- read_csv("data/synthetic-schools.csv", skip = 4, 
                   col_names = c("school_id", "school_name", "region", "school_type", 
                                "funding_type", "total_enrollment", "established_year", 
                                "latitude", "longitude"))
enrollment <- read_csv("data/synthetic-enrollment.csv", skip = 6,
                      col_names = c("School_ID", "Academic_Year", "Total_Students", 
                                   "Kindergarten", "Grade_1", "Grade_2", "Grade_3", "Grade_4", 
                                   "Grade_5", "Grade_6", "Grade_7", "Grade_8", "Grade_9", 
                                   "Grade_10", "Grade_11", "Grade_12", "Special_Needs_Students", 
                                   "English_Learners"))
performance <- read_csv("data/synthetic-performance.csv", skip = 4,
                       col_names = c("school_id", "academic_year", "math_proficiency", 
                                    "reading_proficiency", "science_proficiency", "overall_rating",
                                    "graduation_rate", "attendance_rate", "teacher_retention"))

# Data preparation
current_year <- "2024-2025"
performance_current <- performance |> filter(academic_year == current_year)
enrollment_current <- enrollment |> filter(academic_year == current_year)

# Join datasets for analysis
school_performance <- schools |>
  left_join(performance_current, by = "school_id") |>
  left_join(enrollment_current, by = "school_id")
```

# 📊 National Education Performance Overview

**Report Period:** Academic Year 2024-2025  
**Generated:** `r format(Sys.Date(), "%B %d, %Y")`

---

## 🎯 Key Performance Indicators

```{r kpi-metrics}
kpi_data <- school_performance |>
  summarise(
    total_schools = n(),
    total_students = sum(total_students, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_math = round(mean(math_proficiency, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    avg_reading = round(mean(reading_proficiency, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    excellent_schools = sum(overall_rating == "Excellent", na.rm = TRUE),
    needs_improvement = sum(overall_rating == "Needs Improvement", na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Create styled metrics cards
metrics_display <- tibble(
  Metric = c("Schools", "Students", "Math Proficiency", "Reading Proficiency", "Excellent Schools", "Schools Needing Support"),
  Value = c(
    format(kpi_data$total_schools, big.mark = ","),
    format(kpi_data$total_students, big.mark = ","),
    paste0(kpi_data$avg_math, "%"),
    paste0(kpi_data$avg_reading, "%"),
    format(kpi_data$excellent_schools, big.mark = ","),
    format(kpi_data$needs_improvement, big.mark = ",")
  ),
  Status = c("📈", "👥", "📊", "📚", "⭐", "🚨")
)

gt(metrics_display) |>
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = c(Status, Value)) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(size = px(20)),
    locations = cells_body(columns = Status)
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold", size = px(16)),
    locations = cells_body(columns = Value)
  ) |>
  tab_options(
    table.background.color = "#f8f9fa",
    table.border.top.style = "none",
    table.border.bottom.style = "none",
    column_labels.hidden = TRUE
  )
```

## 📈 Regional Performance Snapshot

```{r regional-summary}
regional_perf <- school_performance |>
  group_by(region) |>
  summarise(
    Schools = n(),
    `Avg Math (%)` = round(mean(math_proficiency, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    `Avg Reading (%)` = round(mean(reading_proficiency, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    `Excellent Schools` = sum(overall_rating == "Excellent", na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(`Avg Math (%)`))

gt(regional_perf) |>
  tab_header(
    title = "Regional Performance Rankings",
    subtitle = "Ordered by Mathematics Performance"
  ) |>
  data_color(
    columns = c(`Avg Math (%)`, `Avg Reading (%)`),
    palette = "viridis",
    domain = c(60, 80)
  ) |>
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(`Avg Math (%)`, `Avg Reading (%)`),
    decimals = 1
  )
```

```{r regional-chart}
#| fig.cap: "Academic Performance by Region - Mathematics and Reading"
regional_chart_data <- school_performance |>
  group_by(region) |>
  summarise(
    Math = mean(math_proficiency, na.rm = TRUE),
    Reading = mean(reading_proficiency, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Math, Reading), names_to = "Subject", values_to = "Score")

p1 <- ggplot(regional_chart_data, aes(x = reorder(region, Score), y = Score, fill = Subject)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#1B4B76", "#2E7BC6")) +
  labs(
    title = "Regional Academic Performance Comparison",
    x = "Region", 
    y = "Average Proficiency (%)",
    fill = "Subject"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

print(p1)
```

## ⚡ Priority Action Items

### 🔴 Immediate Attention Required

```{r priority-schools}
priority_schools <- school_performance |>
  filter(overall_rating == "Needs Improvement") |>
  arrange(math_proficiency) |>
  select(region, school_name, math_proficiency, reading_proficiency, total_students) |>
  slice_head(n = 8)

gt(priority_schools) |>
  cols_label(
    region = "Region",
    school_name = "School",
    math_proficiency = "Math %",
    reading_proficiency = "Reading %",
    total_students = "Students"
  ) |>
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(math_proficiency, reading_proficiency),
    decimals = 1
  ) |>
  tab_header(
    title = "Schools Requiring Immediate Support",
    subtitle = "Lowest performing schools needing intervention"
  ) |>
  data_color(
    columns = c(math_proficiency, reading_proficiency),
    palette = c("red", "orange", "yellow"),
    domain = c(30, 70)
  )
```

### 🟢 Best Practice Examples

```{r exemplary-schools}
exemplary_schools <- school_performance |>
  filter(overall_rating == "Excellent", funding_type == "Public") |>
  arrange(desc(math_proficiency)) |>
  select(region, school_name, math_proficiency, reading_proficiency, teacher_retention) |>
  slice_head(n = 6)

gt(exemplary_schools) |>
  cols_label(
    region = "Region",
    school_name = "School",
    math_proficiency = "Math %",
    reading_proficiency = "Reading %",
    teacher_retention = "Teacher Retention %"
  ) |>
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(math_proficiency, reading_proficiency, teacher_retention),
    decimals = 1
  ) |>
  tab_header(
    title = "Top Performing Public Schools",
    subtitle = "Excellence models for best practice sharing"
  ) |>
  data_color(
    columns = c(math_proficiency, reading_proficiency),
    palette = "Greens",
    domain = c(70, 90)
  )
```
